{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "# LIBERO IMM Two-Stage (Full FT): ACIS-first, then Full Expert FT.
# Based on libero_imm_twostage.yaml but uses full fine-tuning instead of LoRA.
#
# Stage 1: Freeze all expert params, train ACIS only (margin_loss).
#           ACIS learns importance scoring on Full FT-adapted features.
# Stage 2: Freeze ACIS, full fine-tune expert params (action_loss).
#           Expert trains with fixed token selection mask (no LoRA).
#
# Usage:
#   python train_twostage.py --config configs/libero_imm_twostage_fullft.yaml
#   python train_twostage.py --config configs/libero_imm_twostage_fullft.yaml --dry_run

_base_: libero_baseline.yaml

model:
  train_expert_only: true
  lora:
    rank: 0

imm:
  enabled: true
  gradient_isolation: false  # Not needed — stages fully separated
  lambda_margin: 1.0         # Stage 1 margin_loss only, no weighting
  delta: 0.3                 # Hinge margin threshold (same as aloha v8b)
  k_ratio: 0.5              # Retain 50% visual tokens
  temperature: 0.5           # SoftTopK temperature
  soft_topk_method: "sigmoid"
  warmup_steps: 0            # No lambda warmup in two-stage mode

acis:
  visual_dim: 960            # SigLIP connector output dim
  action_dim: 720            # Expert hidden dim
  num_heads: 8
  dropout: 0.0

twostage:
  train_mode: "twostage_fullft"
  # Full FT 100K checkpoint (update path when training completes)
  baseline_checkpoint: "checkpoints/libero_full_ft/step_099999/checkpoint.pt"
  stage1_steps: 10000        # Train ACIS on frozen expert features
  stage2_steps: 20000        # Full fine-tune expert with frozen importance scores
  stage1_lr: 3.0e-4          # Higher LR for small ACIS module
  stage2_lr: 1.0e-4          # Standard expert FT LR (matches libero_full_ft)
  stage1_warmup_steps: 500
  stage2_warmup_steps: 1000
  checkpoint_after_stage1: true
  # Stage 1: freeze expert, train ACIS
  stage1_freeze_backbone: true
  stage1_train_acis: true
  # Stage 2: freeze ACIS, full FT expert
  stage2_freeze_acis: true
  stage2_train_expert_only: true

training:
  output_dir: "checkpoints/libero_imm_twostage_fullft"
  total_steps: 30000         # stage1(10K) + stage2(20K)
  grad_clip: 10.0
  save_every: 2000
  eval_every: 999999         # Skip in-training eval
  log_every: 50
  batch_size: 4
